name: AutoLeaveAdvance
reason: The old effect check is too weak even if corrected code passes it. Replace its retry alternative, check pending on success, and prohibit appending on non-crossing Advances. Separately repair the old observer, which did not record oldApplied/oldPending and omitted cursor>0 from eligibility.
proposed_predicate: For every valid Advance, let trigger = before.role=Leader AND before.config.autoLeave AND cursor>0 AND before.applied<before.pendingConf AND before.pendingConf<=cursor. If trigger, afterHist = beforeHist concatenated with exactly one entry whose index=beforeLast+1, term=before.term, kind=V2, id=0, changes=<<>>, transition=Auto and payload weight=0; after.pendingConf=beforeLast+1; no quota rejection or fatal is permitted. If not trigger, afterHist=beforeHist and after.pendingConf=before.pendingConf. The applied cursor and preservation requirements remain in AckPreservation. Require quotaAfter=max(0,quotaBefore-Weight(batch.committed)).

name: AutoLeaveCompletion
reason: Automatic transition out of an implicit joint configuration is still required. A crossing-only Advance predicate must not silently excuse a joint configuration stranded by an allowed early-Advance/application order.
proposed_predicate: For an applied auto-leaving joint configuration, if an eligible leader remains stable, both joint majorities and storage remain available, communication/ticks/Ready/application callbacks are fairly serviced, and no conflicting external configuration request intervenes, the configuration eventually leaves joint state. This includes legal schedules in which the configuration callback runs after Advance has already acknowledged its entry. The local implementation must arrange a leave proposal once the applied configuration permits it; requiring the applied cursor to cross the same pending index again is not an acceptable liveness premise. Existing ManagementProgress only concerns already committed request IDs and does not establish internal auto-leave initiation.
observer_maintenance: Identify the applied joint-configuration episode and its entry index independently from the raft applied cursor; retain ordered application jobs and separate Advance/ApplyEntry actions. Do not force EarlyAdvance=false to eliminate the schedule.

name: OutcomeSoundness
reason: The new test explicitly requires empty entries to remain admissible above the cap. This does not authorize exempting every configuration entry from the payload limit.
proposed_predicate: Keep all role, membership, forwarding and transfer branches of ExpectedDecision. In its eligible-leader branch use DropQuota iff quota>0 AND effectivePayloadWeight>0 AND quota+effectivePayloadWeight>MaxUncommitted; otherwise Accepted. Weight is the sum of len(Data) after configuration rewriting, not encoded Entry size. A nonempty message containing zero-payload entries is distinct from an empty MsgProp.

name: ProposalConfigurationDecisions
reason: The added admission guards must be checked in both directions and per batch position. The old observer collapses incoming/outgoing membership into a union, which cannot determine joint state. Preserve the public LeaveJoint classification despite a conflicting new source guard.
proposed_predicate: Observe the full pre-configuration, pre-pending cursor and the ordered input entry batch. For an eligible leader, process entries left to right using a local pending cursor P initially equal to before.pendingConf and the unchanged pre-application configuration C. A configuration entry is rewritten to an empty normal entry iff P>applied OR (C is joint AND the entry is not an actual LeaveJoint) OR (C is not joint AND the entry is an actual LeaveJoint). Actual LeaveJoint means V2, no changes, Transition=Auto, ignoring Context; legacy AsV2 always contains one change, including NodeID=0. Rewriting must not advance P. Otherwise preserve the configuration entry and set P=beforeLast+batchPosition. Preserve normal entries. Decide quota from the whole effective batch using the positive-weight condition in OutcomeSoundness. On Accepted append exactly that batch, preserving content, payload weight and encoded size, assigning current term and consecutive indices; after.pendingConf=P. On quota drop the log is unchanged (the separate pending-on-drop concern remains unresolved). Retain the old role/forwarding/transfer behavior. Do not redefine LeaveJoint as merely len(Changes)=0.

proposed_predicate: Retain CampaignContract, including exact request multiplicity/recipients, current log freshness, learner/nonvoter rejection, tick eligibility, and blocking on all unapplied ConfKinds. Do not exempt an automatically generated V2 leave merely because id=0. Keep joint quorum evidence in QuorumAccounting.

Self-removed/demoted-leader early-return behavior is a separately unresolved case.
